title: AMBRE
description:
The Ambre fragrance collection explores warmth, depth, and sensuality through rich, enveloping compositions. Defined by notes of vanilla, resins, balsams, and soft woods, amber perfumes create a lasting impression that feels both intimate and refined. These fragrances evolve slowly on the skin, revealing layers of sweetness, spice, and creamy warmth.

Perfect for evening wear or colder seasons, amber scents bring a sense of comfort and quiet confidence. Whether interpreted through modern musks or deeper resinous accords, the ambre family offers a timeless olfactory signature. Discover luxury amber perfumes designed to linger, captivate, and elevate everyday rituals with a sophisticated, long-lasting trail.

title: CITRUSY
description:
The Citrusy fragrance collection captures freshness in its most vibrant form. Built around notes such as bergamot, lemon, mandarin, and grapefruit, citrus perfumes offer an immediate sense of clarity and energy. These compositions open with a bright, sparkling character that feels clean, uplifting, and effortlessly modern.

Often combined with aromatic herbs or soft woods, citric fragrances evolve beyond their freshness while maintaining a crisp, refined edge. Ideal for daytime wear, warmer climates, or those who favour light and invigorating scents, this collection brings a luminous, contemporary approach to perfumery. Discover fresh citrus perfumes that awaken the senses and leave a subtle, elegant trail.

title: EARTHY
description:
The Earthy fragrance collection is grounded in depth, texture, and natural elegance. Featuring notes such as patchouli, vetiver, woods, and mineral accords, these perfumes evoke the richness of the earth and the complexity of raw materials. Earthy fragrances are often dry, slightly smoky, and deeply expressive, offering a sophisticated alternative to sweeter compositions.

These scents unfold with a sense of structure and authenticity, creating a lasting impression that feels both modern and timeless. Ideal for those who appreciate understated luxury and character-driven perfumes, the earthy family brings balance, depth, and quiet intensity. Discover fragrances that connect nature, texture, and refined craftsmanship.

title: FLORAL
description:
The Floral fragrance collection celebrates the timeless beauty of flowers through modern, refined compositions. Built around notes such as rose, jasmine, orange blossom, and white florals, these perfumes express elegance, softness, and complexity. Floral fragrances can range from fresh and luminous to rich and opulent, offering versatility across moods and occasions.

Blended with musks, woods, or subtle sweetness, florals evolve gracefully on the skin, revealing depth beyond their delicate opening. This collection embodies both classic perfumery and contemporary creativity. Discover luxury floral perfumes designed to enhance individuality, bringing a sophisticated and expressive signature to every moment.

title: FRUITY
description:
The Fruity fragrance collection captures the vibrant, expressive character of ripe fruits through modern perfumery. Notes such as plum, raspberry, peach, and exotic fruits create compositions that feel luminous, playful, and sophisticated. Far from being overly sweet, contemporary fruity perfumes are often balanced with woods, musks, or spices, adding depth and elegance to their juicy opening.

These fragrances evolve beautifully on the skin, moving from bright freshness to a smoother, more refined drydown. Ideal for those seeking a distinctive yet approachable scent, the fruity family offers versatility across seasons and occasions. Discover luxury fruity perfumes designed to feel radiant, modern, and effortlessly captivating.

title: FULL COLLECTION
description:
Every fragrance in the Reinvented collection is composed as an extrait de parfum, the highest concentration in fine perfumery, for depth and longevity on skin. The range moves across ten olfactive families — amber, citrus, earthy, floral, fruity, gourmand, oriental, powdery, spicy and woody — so each scent holds its own character while remaining part of one house signature.

Alongside the permanent line, limited editions such as Enigmatic Aura and Ode To Psyche are produced in restricted quantities and are not reissued once sold out.

New to the house? Begin with the Discovery Set to explore the collection in miniature before committing to a full bottle.

title: GOURMAND
description:
The Gourmand fragrance collection explores indulgence through rich, edible-inspired compositions. Built around notes such as vanilla, caramel, chocolate, and creamy accords, gourmand perfumes evoke warmth, comfort, and sensuality. These fragrances are enveloping and addictive, creating a soft yet long-lasting presence on the skin.

Balanced with woods, spices, or musks, gourmand scents achieve a refined elegance that goes beyond sweetness. Perfect for evening wear or cooler seasons, they offer a comforting and memorable signature. Discover luxury gourmand perfumes that blend sophistication with indulgence, delivering a scent experience that feels both intimate and irresistible.

title: ORIENTAL
description:
The Oriental fragrance collection is defined by richness, opulence, and depth. Featuring notes such as oud, amber, spices, and resins, these perfumes create a warm and captivating olfactory signature. Oriental fragrances are often intense and long-lasting, unfolding in layers that reveal complexity and sensuality over time.

Blending tradition with modern craftsmanship, this family evokes a sense of mystery and sophistication. Ideal for evening wear or statement moments, oriental perfumes leave a powerful and memorable trail. Discover luxury oriental fragrances that combine intensity, elegance, and timeless allure in every composition.

title: POWDERY
description:
The Powdery fragrance collection expresses softness, elegance, and refined intimacy. Characterised by notes such as iris, soft musks, and creamy woods, powdery perfumes create a delicate, velvety texture on the skin. These compositions evoke the sensation of clean skin, fine cosmetics, and understated luxury.

Often subtle yet long-lasting, powdery fragrances develop into a smooth, comforting trail that feels both modern and timeless. Ideal for those who favour minimal, skin-like scents, this collection offers a quiet sophistication. Discover luxury powdery perfumes designed to enhance presence through softness, balance, and effortless refinement

title: SPICY
description:
The Spicy fragrance collection brings energy, warmth, and character through vibrant, aromatic compositions. Notes such as cinnamon, pepper, cardamom, and cloves create perfumes that feel dynamic and expressive. Spicy fragrances often open with a bold intensity before settling into a warm, sophisticated base.

Combined with woods, resins, or amber, these scents gain depth and longevity while maintaining their distinctive edge. Ideal for those seeking a confident and memorable signature, the spicy family offers both modernity and intensity. Discover luxury spicy perfumes that deliver warmth, contrast, and refined complexity.

title: WOODY
description:
The Woody fragrance collection embodies structure, depth, and timeless sophistication. Built around notes such as sandalwood, cedarwood, vetiver, and dry woods, these perfumes create a refined and versatile olfactory profile. Woody fragrances can range from smooth and creamy to dry and textured, offering a balanced and enduring character.

Often combined with spices, musks, or subtle sweetness, woody scents evolve elegantly on the skin, making them suitable for both day and evening wear. This collection reflects modern minimalism and classic craftsmanship. Discover luxury woody perfumes that deliver understated elegance and a lasting impression.
